excluded_interrupted_attempt.reason: A new game session started during the initial full-matrix attempt; the post-process guard stopped the run. All timing samples from this attempt are excluded from the final comparison.

limits: Frame starts carry owned IDs; command batches and final completion must match the active frame. Missing GPU-owner assignment and stale frame IDs are rejected before drawing.
Held-worker probes demonstrate first-group capture before GPU frame setup. Final completion retains the GPU drain; no cross-frame pipelining is tested.
Native group/effect ownership and callbacks remain on the producer. Only fixed retained resources and two warmed single-pass effects are qualified.
The existing Begin(flags=7) versus native flags=6 failure-equivalence limit, cold effects, deferred driver errors and live resource/window/Reset integration remain open.
The initial interrupted full-matrix attempt is excluded from all final timing aggregates. Its raw report and log hashes are retained separately.
Seven rotated timing paths retain complete producer preparation, queue waits and GPU completion; individual lit/shadow workloads cannot be summed into a gameplay prediction.
The unchanged installed beta.13 has not met the 60 FPS target; these synthetic tests provide neither gameplay FPS nor multiplayer validation.
decision: Do not promote the frame-start change alone: the installed DXVK backend has mixed paired results. Preserve the validated frame protocol for a later, separately qualified bounded-frame pipeline.
next_boundary: Own per-frame output, counts and resource lifetime; hold ownership mode fixed while frames are pending. Compare native and queued paths with equal final GPU completion, retaining per-frame-drained controls and intermediate-frame image checks. Full scene/Present and live lifecycle remain unqualified.
